One line, a fact stamp. Add a clause only to state what happens instead (e.g. 6809 has no `events` utility because it uses `F$Send`/`F$Icpt`/`F$Sleep` signals rather than 68k's named-event objects) - never describe the syntax the absent thing *would* have had. |
| `Flag` | Two or more sources disagree; unresolved. |

`Absent` and `Flag` are status flags, not evidence tiers - they sit alongside
the others rather than replacing them.

## `Live` names the implementation it was run on
